description: This file is a shell script for managing prebuilt tools within a build environment. It provides functions for extracting tar files, refreshing timestamps critical for build dependencies, and processing command-line arguments to configure directories and operations related to tool management.

methods.name: refresh_timestamps
methods.description: Updates timestamps of files in a specified directory to force rebuild dependencies.

methods.name: extract_prebuilt_tar
methods.description: Extracts a tar archive containing prebuilt tools.

methods.name: refresh_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Refreshes timestamps of build and staging directories for tools, ensuring they are up to date.

methods.name: install_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Extracts tools from a tar archive and refreshes related timestamps.
